text: Centralized platform fees charged to requesters for the right to submit tasks exert downward pressure on worker compensation, so the fee structure itself is what depresses pay.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Mechanical Turk Through Verified Reputation (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3128900

isBasedOn.name: Decentralized Mechanical Turk Through Verified Reputation

abstract: Such centralized fees add downward pressure on the platforms' worker compensation.

value: centralized marketplaces such as Crowdflower and MTurk
